verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS. Terminals can plausibly ship a built-in AI agent, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions a natural-language AI agent or any repository or pull-request insight feature. Installing pure-Python packages via pip is only a user-side building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests
